title: «El carbunclo azul», The Strand Magazine, enero de 1892

parts.text: Aventuras de Sherlock Holmes VII\. — El carbunclo azul {{#navidad q:navidad|La segunda mañana después de Navidad fui a visitar a mi amigo [[holmes|Sherlock Holmes]], con la intención de desearle felices fiestas.}} {{#sombrero e:holmes q:sombrero|Junto al diván había una silla de madera, y del ángulo del respaldo colgaba un [[sombrero_de_fieltro|sombrero de fieltro duro]], raído y de mala traza, muy estropeado y agrietado en varios sitios.}} Una lupa y unas pinzas sobre el asiento daban a entender que lo habían colgado así para examinarlo. —Supongo —observé— que, por humilde que parezca, esta cosa es la pista que ha de guiarlo a la solución de algún misterio y al castigo de algún crimen. —No, no; ningún crimen —dijo Sherlock Holmes, riendo. {{#seis_casos q:seis_casos|—Tanto es así —observé— que de los seis últimos casos que he agregado a mis notas, tres han estado del todo libres de delito legal.}} {{#papeles e:holmes q:papeles|—Precisamente: alude usted a mi intento de recobrar los papeles de [[irene_adler|Irene Adler]], al singular caso de la señorita [[mary_sutherland|Mary Sutherland]] y a la aventura del [[neville_st_clair|hombre del labio retorcido]].}} {{#peterson e:holmes q:peterson|¿Conoce usted a [[peterson|Peterson]], el ordenanza?}}

src_en.navidad: I had called upon my friend Sherlock Holmes upon the second morning after Christmas, with the intention of wishing him the compliments of the season.
src_en.sombrero: Beside the couch was a wooden chair, and on the angle of the back hung a very seedy and disreputable hard-felt hat, much the worse for wear, and cracked in several places.
src_en.seis_casos: So much so,” I remarked, “that of the last six cases which I have added to my notes, three have been entirely free of any legal crime.
src_en.papeles: Precisely. You allude to my attempt to recover the Irene Adler papers, to the singular case of Miss Mary Sutherland, and to the adventure of the man with the twisted lip.
src_en.ganso: The goose, Mr. Holmes! The goose, sir!
src_en.buche: See what my wife found in its crop!
src_en.piedra: He held out his hand and displayed upon the centre of the palm a brilliantly scintillating blue stone, rather smaller than a bean in size
src_en.la_piedra: It’s more than a precious stone. It is the precious stone.
src_en.morcar: Not the Countess of Morcar’s blue carbuncle!
src_en.anuncio: Precisely so. I ought to know its size and shape, seeing that I have read the advertisement about it in The Times every day lately.
src_en.cosmopolitan: It was lost, if I remember aright, at the Hotel Cosmopolitan
src_en.cinco_dias: Precisely so, on December 22nd, just five days ago.
